name: agenda-card
title: Agenda Card
description: A day-at-a-glance widget: the date lit by a blue glow, events sliding in, and a bar that fills for the one under way.

perf.budget: The glow, rows and fill run short UI-thread springs and timings on arrival and on change. Nothing animates at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: The glow, rows and fills appear in place; the add button does not turn.
a11y.screenReader: The date reads as one line ("Thursday, Oct 30, 6 events"), each event as one line ("Focus Time, 11:00 to 13:00, now"), and the add button as "Add event".
a11y.touchTarget: Event rows are at least 44 pt tall; the add button is 48 pt.

meta.guide:
## Usage

```tsx
import { AgendaCard } from '@/components/kinetik/agenda-card';

<AgendaCard
  date="Oct 30"
  weekday="Thursday"
  events={[
    { id: '1', title: 'Team standup', start: '09:30', end: '09:45' },
    { id: '2', title: 'Deep work', start: '10:00', end: '12:00', progress: 0.4 },
    { id: '3', title: 'Design review', start: '13:30', end: '14:30' },
  ]}
  onAdd={openNewEvent}
  onEventPress={(e) => router.push(`/events/${e.id}`)}
/>;
```

## When to use

- A home-screen style glance at today: the date, a count and the next few events.

## When not to use

- Full calendars or long agendas: use Month Calendar or Timeline.

## Notes

- The first `limit` events are listed (3 by default). `total` sets the count on the date panel when the day has more.
- Give the event under way a `progress` (0–1): its bar dims and fills to match, and screen readers hear "now".
- Events added later slide in at once; the ones there from the start stagger in.
- The card is night-blue on both themes so the glow reads. The add button only shows with `onAdd`.

docs: Prefer `npx kinetik-ui add agenda-card`: it installs dependencies with expo install, so versions match your Expo SDK.
